body_text:
If a holomorphic function has nonzero derivative at $z_0$, it is
conformal there: it preserves oriented angles and scales all
infinitesimal directions by the same factor $|f'(z_0)|$. When
$f'(z_0)=0$, angle preservation can fail, so holomorphy alone does
not imply conformality at every point.
